 Arthur Fils now knows which of two opponents he could face at the Rolex Paris Masters. Meanwhile, Benjamin Bonzi has his work cut out for him as he takes on world No. 13 Taylor Fritz.
 Arthur Fils in Madrid in 2026. © AFP Arthur Millot 01/11/2026, 16:41 1 min to read Follow us Bonzi Fils Fritz Jacquet Machac A scare, but no serious damage for Arthur Fils, who will indeed be in Nanterre to play the final Masters 1000 of the year.
 The player, now ranked world No. 7 in the live rankings (his career-best), stated that "everything is fine." He is therefore preparing for his opening match, scheduled for Tuesday or Wednesday.
 Remove ads With his participation now confirmed, his fans are waiting to find out who his first opponent will be.
 Well, Fils will face the winner of the match between Kyrian Jacquet (WC) and Tomáš Macháč (qualified).
 Bonzi faces a major first-round challenge
 For his part, Benjamin Bonzi just secured his spot in the main draw. Granted a wild card into qualifying, he won both of his matches.
 A major challenge awaits him in the first round, however, as he will take on world No. 13 Taylor Fritz.
 The two players have met only once before, in the third round of the Madrid Masters 1000, on clay.
 The Frenchman retired after winning the first set 6-4 and losing the second 7-5.
